---
title: "The IPBES long-term vision of data and knowledge management"
# Version, release date, release notes and DOI are not stored here: scripts/release.py
# adds them from the release form. title, produced_by, publisher, contact_email, editors
# and next_version (the version this text is prepared as, chosen at export) are updated
# by the Google Doc import; the text itself is in _content.md.
next_version: "2.0"
produced_by: "IPBES task force on knowledge and data"
publisher: "IPBES secretariat, Bonn, Germany"
contact_email: "tsu.data@ipbes.net"
editors:
  - name: "Rainer M Krug"
    institution: "University of Zurich"
    orcid: "0000-0002-7490-0066"
  - name: "Aidin Niamir"
    institution: "Senckenberg Society for Nature Research"
    orcid: "0000-0003-4511-3407"
zenodo:
  concept_doi: "10.5281/zenodo.5513473"          # production "all versions" DOI
  sandbox_concept_doi: "10.5072/zenodo.472195"   # used when ZENODO_TARGET=sandbox
  access_right: "closed"     # open | closed | restricted; closed for now (decision 2026-10-29)
  license: "cc-by-4.0"       # applied by Zenodo when access_right is open
format:
  html:
    output-file: index.html
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    format-links: false
  pdf:
    papersize: a4
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    geometry:
      - left=2.0cm
      - right=2.5cm
      - top=1.0cm
      - bottom=1.4cm
      - includeheadfoot
    classoption:
      - titlepage
    template-partials:
      - templates/title.tex
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
# Release values come from scripts/release.py as IPBES_* environment variables.
release <- function(key) Sys.getenv(paste0("IPBES_", toupper(key)))
meta <- rmarkdown::metadata

version <- if (nzchar(release("version"))) release("version") else "draft"
release_notes <- if (nzchar(release("release_notes"))) release("release_notes") else "Not released yet."
release_date <- if (nzchar(release("release_date"))) release("release_date") else "unreleased"
release_year <- if (nzchar(release("release_year"))) release("release_year") else format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")
doi <- release("doi")
concept_doi <- meta$zenodo$concept_doi

doi_text <- if (nzchar(doi)) {
  sprintf("[%s](https://doi.org/%s)", doi, doi)
} else if (nzchar(release("prerelease"))) {
  "None (pre-release)"
} else {
  "**Will be inserted upon release**"
}
editor_text <- paste(vapply(meta$editors, function(e) e$name, ""), collapse = ", ")
citation_line <- sprintf(
  "IPBES (%s): *%s*, version %s, %s (eds.). %s. DOI: %s",
  release_year, meta$title, version, editor_text, meta$publisher, doi_text
)

# Website only: banner saying what kind of version this is, and a compact "About this version" card.
current <- if (nzchar(release("current_release"))) release("current_release") else "1.0"
current_link <- sprintf('<a href="https://doi.org/%s">version %s</a>', concept_doi, current)
doi_html <- if (nzchar(doi)) sprintf('<a href="https://doi.org/%s">%s</a>', doi, doi) else
  if (nzchar(release("prerelease"))) "none (pre-release)" else "none (draft)"
banner <- if (nzchar(release("prerelease"))) {
  c("prerelease", "exclamation-triangle", sprintf(
    "<b>%s %s</b> &middot; for review, not for citation &middot; the current released version is %s",
    if (grepl("-beta\\.", version)) "Beta" else "Pre-release", version, current_link))
} else if (nzchar(doi)) {
  c("release", "check-circle", sprintf("<b>Version %s</b> &middot; released %s &middot; cite it with DOI %s", version, release_date, doi_html))
} else {
  c("draft", "pencil", sprintf("<b>Working draft</b> &middot; not released, no DOI &middot; the current released version is %s", current_link))
}
li <- function(md) paste0("<ul>", paste0("<li>", sub("^- ", "", strsplit(md, "\n")[[1]]), "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>")
citation_html <- sprintf("IPBES (%s): <i>%s</i>, version %s, %s (eds.). %s. DOI: %s",
                         release_year, meta$title, version, editor_text, meta$publisher, doi_html)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
```{r, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('<div class="status-banner status-%s"><i class="bi bi-%s"></i><span>%s</span></div>\n', banner[1], banner[2], banner[3]))
cat(sprintf('<div class="version-card"><div class="facts">
<div><div class="label">Version</div>%s</div><div><div class="label">Date</div>%s</div>
<div><div class="label">DOI</div>%s</div><div><div class="label">Editors</div>%s</div></div>
<details><summary>Release notes</summary>%s</details>
<details><summary>How to cite</summary><p>%s</p></details></div>
<div class="vision-start"></div>\n',
  version, release_date, doi_html, editor_text,
  if (grepl("^- ", release_notes)) li(release_notes) else paste0("<p>", release_notes, "</p>"), citation_html))
```

## Release Metadata {.unnumbered}

- **Version:** `r version`
- **Release date:** `r release_date`
- **DOI:** `r doi_text`
- **Latest-version DOI:** `r sprintf("[%s](https://doi.org/%s)", concept_doi, concept_doi)`
- **PDF:** Download the latest PDF from the website.
